uk.permission_basis: Publisher-owned official API documentation explicitly permits commercial/noncommercial reuse under OGL v3 with attribution. This pilot accepts domestic legislation metadata only; no EU-derived or pre1987 Westlaw resources.
uk.attribution: © Crown and database right. Derived from legislation.gov.uk metadata under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Normalized metadata; no official endorsement.
uk.allowed_scope: Titles, official resource/instrument IDs, supplied subjects/type/year/number/ISBN/CreationDate, website publication/update clocks and supplied Supersedes attributes
uk.excluded_scope: Summaries, linked legal text/PDF bodies, images/logos, persons/contacts and inferred legal applicability
uk.documented_request_limit: 3000 requests per five minutes per user; lower practical rates required by robots policy
uk.contact_details: Recommended by publisher, not supplied; no fabricated contact
uk.license_document_read_outcome: Official standalone OGL URL returned403 in web tool; no retry/bypass. Exact publisher licensing/scope documentation was accessible.

us.permission_basis: NARA permits Federal Register reproduction. Library of Congress warns that reprinted third-party works can retain rights. Pilot therefore exports official title and structured publication metadata, excluding abstracts and document bodies.
us.attribution: Office of the Federal Register, National Archives and Records Administration / U.S. Government Publishing Office; FederalRegister.gov API metadata. Unofficial API rendition; consult the linked official govinfo edition. Normalized metadata; no endorsement.
us.allowed_scope: Titles, document numbers/types, citation, action labels, supplied agency IDs/names/parent references, CFR/docket/RIN references, date-only publication/effective/comment dates and official URLs
us.excluded_scope: Abstracts, reprinted third-party material, linked legal text/PDF bodies, contacts, persons and inferred binding/applicability status
us.authentication: No API key required by official API documentation
us.request_rate_limit_basis: No numeric rate SLA verified; pilot made two separately bounded requests with no retries

eurlex.observed_outcome: JavaScript robot verification required in direct web reads
